record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of non-uniform hyperbolicity
record.context_brief: Full-measure basin for a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure
record.original_question: Assume a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure μ supported on a topological attractor Λ exists. Under what conditions does the basin of attraction B(μ) have full measure in the trapping region U?

evidence.quote: 2. Suppose a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure supported on Λ exists. Under what conditions does the basin of attraction B(µ) have full measure in the trapping region U?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:M\to M$ be a $C^{1+\alpha}$ diffeomorphism of a compact Riemannian manifold $M$. Suppose $U\subset M$ is an open set with $\overline{f(U)}\subset U$ (a trapping region), and let $\Lambda=\bigcap_{n\ge 0} f^n(U)$ be the corresponding topological attractor. Recall that an $f$-invariant Borel probability measure $\mu$ supported on $\Lambda$ is called a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure if all of its Lyapunov exponents are nonzero $\mu$-almost everywhere and its conditional measures on unstable manifolds are absolutely continuous with respect to the Lebesgue measure induced on those unstable manifolds. The basin of attraction of $\mu$ is
$$B(\mu)=\Big\{x\in M : \tfrac{1}{n}\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}\delta_{f^k(x)}\xrightarrow[n\to\infty]{w^*}\mu\Big\}.$$
Assume such a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure $\mu$ supported on $\Lambda$ exists.

Problem: Determine general dynamical, geometric, or measure-theoretic conditions on $(f,U,\Lambda,\mu)$ under which $B(\mu)$ has full Lebesgue measure in the trapping region $U$, i.e. $\mathrm{Leb}(U\setminus B(\mu))=0$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of when the basin of an SRB measure has full Lebesgue measure in a trapping region is a long-standing open problem in smooth ergodic theory. While positive results exist under additional hypotheses (uniform hyperbolicity, partial hyperbolicity with mostly contracting center, existence of a unique SRB with dense unstable manifolds, etc.), no general necessary-and-sufficient criterion in the purely non-uniformly hyperbolic setting is known.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in the theory of non-uniform hyperbolicity
status_evidence.snippet: Listed as an open problem regarding when the basin of a non-uniformly hyperbolic SRB measure has full measure in the trapping region.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as open in a published list of open problems on non-uniform hyperbolicity.
